# Implementation Plan: Claude models via Copilot `/chat/completions` transport (D-001)
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"codex-anthropic-models-support"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-08. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*

## Overview

codex (this fork) is **Responses-API-only**: its `WireApi` enum has a single `Responses`
variant, the Copilot provider hardcodes it, and the transport dispatch in
`core/src/client.rs` is a single-arm `match`. GitHub Copilot serves every Claude model
**only** via `/chat/completions` (+ `/v1/messages`), **never** `/responses` (source-settled
by a live `GET api.githubcopilot.com/models` probe, 2026-06-08). A Claude model therefore
cannot be surfaced or run today, and a filter/metadata-only relaxation would produce a false
affordance (a Responses body POSTed to an endpoint Copilot does not serve for Claude).

This plan builds a **fork-local `/chat/completions` transport** that translates codex's
internal Responses request/response/SSE to/from Copilot's chat-completions wire, routed
**per-model** so a Claude row runs over chat while GPT-5.x keeps running over `/responses`,
all through the **existing** Copilot provider and existing auth (egress stays
`api.githubcopilot.com`, no new credentials). The work is **spike-gated** — Story 1 is a
Phase-0 GO/NO-GO feasibility spike that must prove the hard part (a streamed **typed**
tool-call, **parallel/interleaved** tool calls, a continuation turn, usage accounting, and an
apply_patch/edit) against a **live** Copilot call before the full build starts — and
**contract-scoped**: an explicit, test-enforced table of which Responses features are
supported for Claude vs visibly UI-disabled or hard-errored, so **silent lossy success** is
eliminated by design.

The bulk of the new code (request-body translation + streaming SSE→event translation +
tool-call/vision mapping) lives in the existing fork-exclusive overlay crate
`codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/` (zero upstream-canonical conflict surface, per fork tenet
#1). The upstream-canonical edits are small and `// SANDBOX PATCH:`-marked, and the plan is
**honest about the full set** (see "Upstream-canonical surface" below) — it is NOT limited to
"the WireApi variant + one arm + the filter," because per-model routing and the core seam
each add a small, registered edit.

### Codebase Context

Existing files: `src/{auth.rs, header_source.rs, lib.rs, paths.rs, payload.rs}`; deps reqwest(json,rustls-tls)/serde/serde_json/tokio/http/codex-client/sha2/uuid/dirs. **It does NOT depend on `codex-api`** (and must not — see the cycle constraint below).
  - **Upstream-canonical seam edits** live in the **patched submodule** (`codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/`).
  - `patch-surface.md`, `scripts/audit_network_calls.sh`, `scripts/audit_invariants.sh` live in the **wrapper repo** (`codex/...`).
  - **The patched submodule is NOT independently buildable** outside the wrapper checkout (the overlay path-dep members make it cross-boundary). Implementation happens in a paired worktree and produces **two commits** (submodule seam first, then the wrapper commit recording overlay code + docs + the new gitlink); codexu later records the `codex/` pointer bump (lead-owned at ship).
- **Dependency graph (verified — drives the architecture):**
  - `codex-api` **already depends on** `codex-copilot` (`codex-api/Cargo.toml:17`). So `codex-copilot` **cannot** depend on `codex-api` (would be a Cargo cycle). `ResponseEvent`/`ResponseStream`/`ResponseItem` live in `codex-api` (`codex-api/src/common.rs:72-111, 299-311`).
  - `model-provider-info` (home of `WireApi`) **depends on** `codex-protocol`; `codex-protocol` does **not** depend on `model-provider-info`. So a `ModelInfo` field (in `codex-protocol`) **cannot** be typed `Option<WireApi>` (would be a Cargo cycle).
  - `codex-core` does **not** currently depend on `codex-copilot` (`core/Cargo.toml` has no entry) — the core seam must add that dependency (acyclic: `codex-copilot` depends on neither `codex-api` nor `codex-core`).
- **WireApi enum** `model-provider-info/src/lib.rs:52-82`: `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, JsonSchema)] #[serde(rename_all="lowercase")] enum WireApi { #[default] Responses }`. `Display` match exhaustive (`:61-68`); custom `Deserialize` (`:70-82`) accepts only `"responses"`, hard-errors `"chat"` with `CHAT_WIRE_API_REMOVED_ERROR`, `unknown_variant` otherwise. `ModelProviderInfo.wire_api` is **provider-level** (`:113-115`); `create_copilot_provider()` hardcodes `WireApi::Responses` (`:477-498`).
- **Transport dispatch** `core/src/client.rs:1571-1621`: `pub async fn stream(&mut self, prompt: &Prompt, model_info: &ModelInfo, ...) -> Result<ResponseStream>`; body `let wire_api = self.client.state.provider.info().wire_api; match wire_api { WireApi::Responses => { ... self.stream_responses_api(...).await } }`. **`model_info` is already in scope** here, so per-model routing needs no new parameter. `map_response_stream` (invariant 14) forwards `Completed` before trace I/O.
- **Reasoning is metadata-gated, not silently dropped at request time:** `build_reasoning` (`core/src/client.rs:699-715`) returns `None` when `!model_info.supports_reasoning_summaries`, so codex never *requests* reasoning for a model whose metadata says it is unsupported (synthesize sets `supports_reasoning_summaries: false`). The residual risk is the **response** side — the chat SSE translator must not leak any model "thinking" as an assistant `OutputTextDelta`.
- **`Prompt`** `core/src/client_common.rs:23-46`: `input: Vec<ResponseItem>`, **`tools: Vec<ToolSpec>` and `parallel_tool_calls: bool` are `pub(crate)`** (core-private). So the `Prompt`→chat-body conversion **must** originate in core. The **core** `ResponseStream` (`core/src/client_common.rs:68-87`: `rx_event: mpsc::Receiver<Result<ResponseEvent>>` + `consumer_dropped: CancellationToken` + `Drop`) is what `stream()` returns (distinct from codex-api's `ResponseStream`).
- **Auth/header path** `model-provider/src/copilot.rs:150-172`: `api_auth()` builds `CopilotHeaderSource::new(auth)`, fail-closed on untrusted `base_url`. Overlay `auth.rs` already applies `HeaderValue::set_sensitive(true)` on `Authorization`/`ChatGPT-Account-ID` (redaction invariant 7).
- **`/models` filter** `model-provider/src/copilot_models_endpoint.rs:199-215`: `is_chat_responses_picker_entry` keeps an entry only if `model_picker_enabled && (capabilities.type=="chat" || absent) && supported_endpoints.contains("/responses")`. `synthesize_from_capabilities` (`:230-292`) builds `ModelInfo` for Copilot-only slugs (sets `supports_image_detail_original`/`supports_parallel_tool_calls`/`context_window`/reasoning levels; `supports_reasoning_summaries:false`, `web_search_tool_type`, etc.).
- **`ModelInfo`** is defined in `codex-protocol` at `protocol/src/openai_models.rs:262` and already carries protocol-local bools like `supported_in_api: bool` (`:271`). It IS the cached type — `models-manager/src/cache.rs` stores `Vec<ModelInfo>` (TTL 300s, keyed by path + `client_version` + `etag`), so a new field round-trips automatically; a `client_version` bump forces a one-time refresh of pre-hint caches.
- **Test infra:** `model-provider/src/copilot.rs` uses `wiremock::{MockServer, Mock, ResponseTemplate, method, path}`; `core_test_support::responses` for e2e turns. **Repo rule (codex-rs AGENTS.md): do NOT run `cargo test` directly — use `just test -p <crate>`; run `just fmt`/`just fix -p <crate>` after Rust edits; after Cargo dep changes run `just bazel-lock-update` + `just bazel-lock-check`.** `cargo check --workspace` (~6 min, rustup/cargo installed) is the Phase-5a gate; `cargo test --workspace` is CI-only (`invariant-check.yml`).
- **Precedent (gold standard):** `codex-rs-overlay/codex-stream-diagnostics/` — an overlay crate wrapping an upstream seam via a 1–3 line `// SANDBOX PATCH:` edit + a `patch-surface.md` §14 invariant + a §15 rebase note + an in-crate canary test. This plan mirrors that shape.

### Technical Constraints
- `wire_api` is **provider-level**, but Claude vs GPT must route differently within the **same** Copilot provider → a per-model routing mechanism is required.
- **Two hard layering constraints (verified):** the overlay (`codex-copilot`) must NOT depend on `codex-api` (cycle), and the `ModelInfo` route hint must NOT be typed `WireApi` (cycle). Both shape the design below.
- The overlay cannot see `Prompt` internals (`pub(crate)`), so `Prompt`→chat-body conversion lives in core.
- Dominant failure mode is **silent lossy success**; the spike + the test-enforced contract make every gap loud.
- Streamed tool-call arguments arrive as **partial JSON fragments per `call_id`** and must be assembled into **typed** `function_call` items, never assistant text.
- `cargo build --release` and `cargo test --workspace` are CI-only on this Windows box; the spike's **live** call needs Copilot auth (`codex login --provider copilot`) + network egress.
- Every upstream-canonical edit needs a `// SANDBOX PATCH:` marker + a `patch-surface.md` §14 row (format `| Invariant | One-line description | Enforcement type | Test path or script reference | Deliberate-violation procedure |`; next free numbers ~30+) + a §15 rebase-replant note.

## Approach

### Architecture
1. **Overlay-first placement WITHOUT a dependency cycle.** All chat translation lives in `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/`, but because the overlay sits **below** `codex-api`, it must not reference `codex-api` types:
   - extend `src/payload.rs` with a public, serializable **chat request body** type + a builder from the public turn data core supplies;
   - add `src/chat_completions.rs` that POSTs to `api.githubcopilot.com/chat/completions` (reusing `CopilotHeaderSource`/`auth.rs`), parses the chat SSE stream, and yields a **neutral, overlay-local event representation** (e.g. an overlay `ChatStreamEvent` enum: content delta, tool-call id+name+partial-args delta, finish reason, usage) — NOT `codex_api::ResponseEvent`;
   - register both as `pub mod` in `src/lib.rs`.
   *(Alternative considered: host a shared neutral event type in a low crate like `codex-protocol` so both sides depend on it — wider surface; rejected unless the overlay-local enum proves awkward.)*
2. **Per-model routing = a protocol-local wire-route hint on `ModelInfo`.** Add a `#[serde(default)]` field to `ModelInfo` typed as a **protocol-local** enum (e.g. `ModelWireRoute::{ProviderDefault, ChatCompletions}`) — NOT `Option<WireApi>` (cycle). Set it during model translation (`synthesize_from_capabilities` + the bundled-clone path in `translate_entry`) from the row's `supported_endpoints`: a row advertising `/chat/completions` but not `/responses` ⇒ `ChatCompletions`. The **core** dispatch maps `model_info.wire_route → WireApi` at the boundary (the only place `WireApi` is referenced), falling back to `provider.wire_api`. The hint round-trips through `models_cache.json` (covered by a cache test; `client_version` bump forces a one-time refresh of pre-hint caches). Alternatives rejected: a `stream()`-time `supported_endpoints` lookup (runtime coupling, and `supported_endpoints` is not persisted on `ModelInfo` today) and a second `copilot-chat` provider (splits auth/picker/cache — worst UX).
3. **Thin core seam.** A new **core** module `chat_transport.rs` (NOT added to the already-hot `client.rs`) exposes `stream_chat_completions` that (a) converts the core-private `Prompt` into the overlay's public chat body, (b) drives the overlay POST + SSE parse, (c) **maps the overlay neutral events → `codex_api::ResponseEvent`** (per-`call_id` partial-JSON tool-arg assembly lives here, above `codex-api`), and (d) wraps the result into the **core** `ResponseStream` (owning the mpsc channel, the mapper task, and `consumer_dropped` cancellation). The **only** edit to `client.rs` is one new arm `WireApi::ChatCompletions => self.stream_chat_completions(...).await`. Core gains a `codex-copilot` dependency in `core/Cargo.toml` (acyclic).
4. **The v1 feature contract is enforced at TWO sites, never silently dropped:** at `Prompt`→chat-body construction (hard-error if an unsupported request feature is present) AND in the SSE translator (e.g. reasoning/thinking is dropped deliberately, never emitted as assistant text), in addition to picker/metadata flags.

### Upstream-canonical surface (the honest, full list — each gets `// SANDBOX PATCH:` + §14 row + §15 note)
1. `WireApi::ChatCompletions` variant + `Display` arm + `Deserialize` mapping — `model-provider-info/src/lib.rs`.
2. One new dispatch arm — `core/src/client.rs`.
3. New core module `core/src/chat_transport.rs` + its `mod` registration + the `codex-copilot` dependency in `core/Cargo.toml` (option-2 placement: new file in an upstream crate called from the 1-line seam).
4. `/models` filter relaxation — `model-provider/src/copilot_models_endpoint.rs`.
5. Protocol-local wire-route field on `ModelInfo` (+ its serde default + constructor fan-out) — `protocol/src/openai_models.rs` (+ `models-manager/src/model_info.rs`).
(The bulk of the code — the overlay transport — is in `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/` and carries **zero** upstream-canonical conflict surface.)

### v1 Feature Contract (test-enforced; NEVER silent degradation)
| Responses feature | Source field / event | v1 for Claude-via-chat | Exact gate site | Enforcing test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| typed tool-calls (`function_call`) | `ResponseEvent::ToolCallInputDelta`/`OutputItemDone` | **Supported** (core contract) | SSE translator assembles typed item | wiremock translator test + routing test |
| apply_patch / edit | `core/src/apply_patch.rs`, `tools/handlers/dynamic.rs` | **Supported iff** spike round-trips the tool-call path | tool-call path (same as above) | spike artifact + e2e |
| vision (image input) | `supports_image_detail_original` (`copilot_models_endpoint.rs:281-283`) | **Supported iff** image parts survive | request builder maps `image_url` data-URI | payload unit test |
| parallel tool calls | `supports_parallel_tool_calls` | **Supported iff** spike + translator prove no collapse/reorder | SSE translator (per-`call_id`) | wiremock parallel-call test |
| reasoning summaries | `supports_reasoning_summaries` (synthesize → false); `build_reasoning` `client.rs:699-715` | **Not requested** (metadata=false) + **translator must not leak thinking as text** | `build_reasoning` (already None) + SSE translator gate | test asserts no reasoning request + no thinking-as-`OutputTextDelta` |
| `previous_response_id` / `store` continuity | `ResponseCreateWsRequest.previous_response_id`/`store` (`common.rs:220-239`) | **Hard-error if requested** | `Prompt`→chat-body builder | builder test asserts error |
| structured output | `output_schema`/`text.format` (`client_common.rs:42-45`, `common.rs:140-148`) | **UI-disabled** unless cleanly mappable | request builder + picker capability | builder/capability test |
| web-search | `web_search_tool_type`/`supports_search_tool` (`copilot_models_endpoint.rs:278-291`) | **UI-disabled** | model metadata (synthesize) | capability test |
*(Impl confirms apply_patch + parallel + vision against the spike; anything the spike can't prove ships gated.)*

### Implementation Strategy
Strictly **spike-gated**: no build story starts until Story 1 returns GO.
1. **US-001 — Phase-0 GO/NO-GO spike** (throwaway vertical slice; the gate; now also exercises parallel/interleaved tool calls + usage).
2. **US-002 — WireApi seam** (foundational type change).
3. **US-003 (model surface: filter relaxation + protocol-local route hint + cache + guardrail) & US-004 (overlay transport: chat body builder + neutral SSE translator)** — disjoint files, parallelizable; both depend on US-002. **Shared-file owner rule:** `Cargo.lock` (and any shared `Cargo.toml`) edits are owned by ONE cluster per phase; the other rebases onto the lockfile after it lands. US-004's overlay code is unit-testable standalone (wiremock), but a Claude model is **not selectable/routable end-to-end** until US-003 **and** US-005 land.
4. **US-005 — core dispatch wiring** (`chat_transport.rs` + the one `client.rs` arm + Prompt→body + neutral→`ResponseEvent` map + `core/Cargo.toml` dep) and the **integration flip** that makes Claude rows visible only once the transport exists; depends on US-002/003/004.
5. **US-006 — v1 feature-contract enforcement** (request-build hard-errors live in US-004's builder so no silent path ever exists; US-006 adds the picker UI-disable + the full test matrix); conceptually concurrent with US-004/005, finalized after US-005.
6. **US-007 — audit + invariants + redaction registration**; depends on US-002–US-006.
7. **US-008 — end-to-end agentic validation + GPT-5.x regression**; depends on all.

### Partial-rollout safety (why the guardrail matters)
Relaxing the `/models` filter surfaces chat-only Claude rows. If that lands before dispatch (US-005), a Claude row would be selectable while `stream()` still routes provider-level `WireApi::Responses` → Claude→`/responses` (broken). **The surfacing must be gated on BOTH the route hint AND the chat transport being wired** (e.g. a "chat transport available" const/guard flipped on in US-005). The guardrail test asserts a chat-only Claude row stays **hidden** until both conditions hold (not merely "hint absent").

## Scope
### In Scope
- Phase-0 GO/NO-GO spike (the gate) with a committed artifact and an explicit NO-GO off-ramp.
- The overlay `/chat/completions` transport (request builder + streaming **neutral** SSE translator) reusing existing Copilot auth/headers.
- The five `// SANDBOX PATCH:`-marked upstream seams enumerated above, each with §14/§15 entries.
- An explicit, test-enforced v1 feature contract (supported vs UI-disabled/hard-error per feature) — never silent.
- Copilot-only slug handling (`-1m`/`-high`/`-xhigh`/`-internal`) via `synthesize_from_capabilities`; exact slugs preserved.
- Guardrail regression test (Claude rows stay hidden until hint **and** transport exist) + network-audit + redaction coverage.
- `cargo check --workspace` green; `audit_network_calls.sh` + `audit_invariants.sh` pass.

### Out of Scope
- Anthropic-native `/v1/messages` transport (D-002) — deferred phase-2 fidelity upgrade.
- Any new network egress or credential surface beyond `api.githubcopilot.com`.
- Responses-feature parity where chat cannot faithfully round-trip (gated, not bridged).
- Chat-completions support for non-Copilot providers.
- The codexu-level `codex/` submodule pointer bump (lead-owned at ship).

## Risk Areas
- **Silent lossy success (highest).** Mitigated by the expanded spike (tool-heavy + **parallel** + continuation + **usage** + apply_patch) and the two-site, test-enforced contract.
- **Dependency cycles (resolved by design).** `codex-copilot ↛ codex-api` (overlay yields neutral events; core maps to `ResponseEvent`); `ModelInfo` route hint is protocol-local, not `WireApi`. Both are verified facts, not assumptions.
- **Partial-rollout exposure.** Surfacing chat-only rows before dispatch would route Claude to `/responses`; gated on hint **and** transport-available, asserted by the guardrail test.
- **Streamed tool-call delta desync / parallel interleaving.** Per-`call_id` buffering + parallel tests in US-004; the spike pre-validates parallel ordering.
- **Per-model routing metastasis + cache staleness.** Bounded by the protocol-local hint + a cache round-trip/stale-cache test + a `client_version` bump.
- **Reasoning leakage.** `build_reasoning` already gates the request side; the SSE translator must not emit thinking as assistant text (explicit test).
- **Redaction regression.** New builder preserves `set_sensitive(true)`; redaction test + `audit_invariants.sh` guard.
- **Two-commit topology.** The patched submodule is not standalone-buildable; develop in a paired worktree, commit the submodule seam first, then the wrapper (overlay code + docs + gitlink). codexu pointer bump is lead-owned.
- **Spike prerequisites.** Live Copilot auth + network egress; a non-GO outcome cleanly triggers the D-003 off-ramp.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The Phase-0 spike artifact is committed and demonstrates, against a **live** Copilot `/chat/completions` call for `claude-sonnet-4.6`, either (a) the expected codex `ResponseEvent`/output-item sequence for a streamed **typed** tool-call, **two interleaved (parallel) tool calls**, a continuation turn, usage accounting, and apply_patch (→ GO), or (b) a documented failure that triggers the D-003 off-ramp.
- A Claude model selected in the picker completes an agentic turn end-to-end via the new transport with ≥1 tool-call executed as a typed `function_call` — verified by a **deterministic** `core_test_support::responses`-style integration test asserting the emitted sequence carries a `function_call` (`OutputItemDone`/`ToolCallInputDelta`), never an `OutputTextDelta` carrying the raw tool JSON. A live transcript may supplement but does not replace the deterministic test.
- GPT-5.x still routes through the unchanged `/responses` transport; a Claude row never routes to `/responses` and a GPT row never routes to chat — verified by a routing unit test (dispatch selects `ChatCompletions` for a chat-hinted `ModelInfo`, `Responses` for a `/responses` row) plus a cache round-trip test asserting the route hint survives a re-read of `models_cache.json`; run via `just test -p codex-model-provider` / `just test -p codex-core`.
- The five upstream-canonical edits are each `// SANDBOX PATCH:`-marked with a `patch-surface.md` §14 row and a §15 rebase note; no upstream edit is left untracked.
- Every v1-unsupported Responses feature for Claude is visibly UI-disabled or hard-errored (covered by a test at the request-build and/or translator site), never silently degraded.
- `cargo check --workspace` passes from `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs`; `bash scripts/audit_network_calls.sh` and `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` pass; the new builder preserves `Authorization`/`ChatGPT-Account-ID` `set_sensitive(true)`; after any Cargo dep change, `just bazel-lock-update` + `just bazel-lock-check` are run.

## Suggested Decomposition
A single, tightly-coupled Rust feature in a shared cargo workspace, gated on a spike;
**serial execution is the safer default**. Exactly one phase admits parallelism (disjoint files),
and even there one cluster owns the shared `Cargo.lock`.

### Cluster: spike-gate
- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[none]; exclusive=[throwaway spike branch / internal flag]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Phase-0 gate; must return GO before any build story; nothing runs in parallel with it.

### Cluster: wire-seam
- Stories: US-002
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: spike-gate
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`model-provider-info/src/lib.rs`]; exclusive=[WireApi enum/Display/Deserialize]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Foundational type change other stories reference; lands alone before the parallel phase.

### Cluster: model-surface
- Stories: US-003
